title: Priority Indicator Eligibility + Usability Screening
purpose: Verify that each Step-31A direct candidate can be safely materialized at grid level without leakage, missingness, coverage failure, or zero spatial variation.

screening_rules.leakage: No future observed LST target. Step-28 forecast outputs and frozen Step-29 scenario outputs are eligible.
screening_rules.coverage: Every direct candidate must represent all 2,194 grids.
screening_rules.missingness: Materialized direct candidate values must have zero missing values.
screening_rules.variation: A direct candidate must vary across grids; a citywide constant cannot support grid ranking.
screening_rules.categorical_trajectory: Trajectory class is checked for completeness/variation but is not numerically ordered in Step 31B.
screening_rules.static_context: Static structural variables are not rejected merely because they are time-invariant. They are flagged for planning-relevance review in Step 31C.
screening_rules.scenario_temporal_screen: Scenario candidates are tested using per-grid 2026-2030 mean benefit only as a usability probe. Step 31D/31C selection logic still decides the final representation.
screening_rules.support_layers: SHAP and Step-30 uncertainty remain support-only and never enter CRITIC/TOPSIS directly.
